_note: TEMPLATE ONLY — not data. Declare the real source and its licence honestly.
intended_use = 'research' is always accepted and stamps commercial_use:false
into RIGHTS.json and the build result. Use it for public datasets such as
OpenSinger (CC BY-NC-SA) or VocalSet (CC BY 4.0) when only validating the
pipeline — never to build a library you ship.
intended_use = 'product' is REFUSED unless the licence is not known to be
non-commercial AND rights_verified is true AND consent_ref names the signed
performer consent/release document. An absent or unknown licence fails closed.
Each 'dir' is relative to THIS file and must contain >=1 audio file
(wav/flac/ogg/mp3/m4a). Intake writes the generated catalog with paths
relative to its own output folder, so move the catalog and material together.
Run: python -m voicematch.cli ingest --manifest material-manifest.json --out catalog/
